__note: Specification of Scenario 04. Not an export. No mailbox is connected and nothing is sent.
name: S04 Review notification

idempotency.note: Claimed BEFORE sending. A reviewer must never receive the same notification twice.

invariants: The notification contains a deep link to the record and NO evidence: no photograph, no thumbnail, no public link (SEC-03).
The recipient is resolved from the approval matrix for this project and stage, honouring any valid delegation.
This is an internal notification to a company reviewer. It is NOT external delivery to a client, which requires a Released document and a recipient snapshot (Phase 7).

config.delegation: if a valid, unrevoked, in-window delegation covers this stage and project, notify the delegate and record both identities
